items.summary: Three teams landed M7 wave 2: serialiser, four contracts, authority mapped. Gate passed: 146 tests, seams 10, verification 83.
CB-7 opened. Ignored effect's error field cannot express kernel-b's drop reasons. Field is a closed set of client-facing error kinds.
KernelEffect's Copy derive blocks BlockPartition, which requires a Vec<CopyId>. Both issues folded into CB-7.
All four drift plans re-based to latest commit. M7F-37 was never written. Code evolved to 8 variants, test followed, prose lagged.
G-13 funding decision and F5 shrink-budget acceptance are held at M7 gate.
DuckDB JSON failure is a 16 MiB read buffer cliff on small files. Snapshot control passed 60 of 60.
